title: Kehti hai sakina mere baba nahi aaye
body:
Nouha title-Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
Chaya hai andhera mere baba nahin aaye....
1.Ahsaas e yateeme se bura haal hai mera
Aur khaufe aseeri ne kiya dil me basera
De koun dilasa mere baba nahin aaye....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
2.Hain chaaro'n tarf dasht me khoo'n khaar darinde
Har samt hain sannate adhere hi adhere
Kab hoga sawera mere baba nahin aaye.....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
3.Sab hogae'n saidaniya'n be maqnao chadar
Aur loota sitam garo'n ne Beemar ka bistar
Roota raha bhaiya mere baba nahin aaye....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
4.Gauhar bhi chine mere lage mo pa tamache
Daman me lagi aag lage pusht pa durre
Mai hogayi tanha mere baba nahin aaye....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
5.neend ayegi kounkar mujhe  mitti ka hai bistar
Har lamha ghurukta hai mujhe shimre bad akhtar
Yaad aata hai seena mere baba nahin aye....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
6.istarha se badhen hain gala mera sitamgar
Ankhon me adhera hai zuba'n nikli hai bahar
Dam ghut ta hai mera mere baba nahin aaye.....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
7.toote howe zinda'n me mujhe laye hain ada
Hai shamo seher is me adhera hi adhera
Dushwar hai jina mere baba nahin aaye....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
8.aghoosh me bithlata hai qaidi mera bhaiya
Aur leta hai bosa mere pairo'n ke waramka
Jab kehti hoon bhaiya mere baba nahin aaye.....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
9.jab aata hai peene ke liye mujh ko jo pani
Zanjeero'n pa bhaiya ke chirakti hoon wo pani
Khoon rota hai kunba mere nahin aaye.....
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
10.kehti rahi har gaam pa Shahkar sakina
Zahid raha din raath zuba'n par yahi noha
Aaye nahin baba mere baba nahin aaye...
Kehti hai sakina s.a mere baba a.s nahin aaye
